mainnet.statusNote: Blocked until the conditions of the 2026-11-08 program amendment (openspec/MORIARTY-COMPLETION-PROGRAM.md:270-283, which supersedes the :269 ban) hold: local Docker at 9.1.0.1 passed, the Preview qualification receipts and the Preview rollback rehearsal receipt committed, and the pre-deploy checklist passed. Each mainnet operation is then a T4 operation that needs explicit owner authorization when it runs, under the owner-set spend ceiling with no automatic retry; the amendment authorizes no spend (SWF-009, task 7.1). Blockfrost is the official endpoint; endpoints are added in task 7.2.
